caption_used: 该折线图展示了lattice、FLAT与OURS三种方法在训练过程中F1分数的演变趋势。横轴为训练轮数（epoch），范围从0到18；纵轴为F1分数，范围从0.55至0.90。红色实线带方形标记代表lattice方法，初始F1值约为0.59，在epoch=16时达到约0.85。蓝色实线带圆形标记代表FLAT方法，起始F1值约为0.79，收敛速度较快。黄色实线带三角形标记代表OURS方法，初始F1值约为0.82，最终在epoch=16达到约0.90。值得注意的是，FLAT方法在epoch=8附近即超越OURS，两者在中间阶段表现接近，而lattice方法虽起步较慢但在后期展现出与FLAT相当的增长速率。
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The line chart illustrates the evolution of F1 scores for three different methods—lattice, FLAT, and OURS—over 18 training epochs. The x-axis, labeled "epoch (epoch)," ranges from 0 to 18, while the y-axis, labeled "F1 score," ranges from 0.55 to 0.90. The lattice method, represented by a red line with square markers, starts with an F1 score of approximately 0.59 and reaches about 0.85 by epoch 16. The FLAT method, indicated by a blue line with circular markers, begins with an F1 score of around 0.79 and shows a faster convergence, surpassing the OURS method around epoch 8. The OURS method, depicted by a yellow line with triangular markers, starts with an F1 score of about 0.82 and achieves the highest F1 score of approximately 0.90 by epoch 16.
